name: Audio Studio
intro: Audio Studio generates music, speech and sound effects from a text prompt, using the model you pick, all in one place.

features.model-selector: Pick your audio model at the top. Different models are built for songs, speech, sound effects or voice cloning, and your last choice is remembered.
features.prompt: The prompt is your main instruction. Describe the music you want, or type the exact words for a speech model to say.
features.style-music: For music models, the Style dropdown steers the genre, with choices like Pop, Jazz, Electronic and Ambient.
features.duration: Duration buttons let you choose how long the track runs, from fifteen seconds up to two minutes.
features.voice-and-speed-speech: For speech models you get a Voice list and a Speed slider, so you can adjust how your narrator sounds.
features.model-specific-controls: Newer models show their own options right under the prompt, such as toggles and dropdowns. Read the small help text to get the most from each one.
features.audio-upload-and-drag-and-drop: Some models need audio to work with. Upload a track, or drop an audio file onto the page, to remix, clone or add vocals.
features.waveform-player-and-audio-editor: After generating, the waveform player lets you listen and download. The Audio Editor below adds trim and fade controls for quick tweaks.

outro: That's Audio Studio. Be specific about genre and mood, and you'll have music, voice-overs and sound effects ready for your videos.
